ety.text: Literally, “on a word of honor and on one wing”. Modified calque of English on a wing and a prayer, expanding the preexisting idiom на че́стном сло́ве (na čéstnom slóve); from T. S. Sikorskaya's and S. B. Bolotin's 1943 Russian translation of the American wartime song Comin' in on a Wing and a Prayer (titled «Бомбардировщики» («Bombardirovščiki») in the translation), sung by Leonid Utesov.
